svg.title: Molecular selection atlas (synthetic)
svg.desc: A karyon sheet of 4 panels in 2 columns: panel A, Capsule width is fitted class weight; colour is omega. Dashed links mark a recurrent branch event.; panel B, Mean branch omega, statistical emphasis, terminal metadata and recurrent events use separate channels.; panel C, Evidence height and signed log2(omega) are separated; diamonds cross the p-value threshold.; panel D, The same effect grammar works with posterior probability without pretending it is a p-value..
